thread:
sophia: FYI ran the embedding reranker eval after the HF->Redwood conversion and we have a clear quality drop on MS MARCO dev set. ~6% MRR down.

alexa: ouch. any obvious difference in tokenization or pooling config?

jordan: how did you run the conversion? which tool/version?

sophia: used rwdx-convert v0.9.1 -> it consumes the HF repo and generates a Redwood model bundle. I noticed it dropped the model card 'pooling' metadata and also changed tokenizer special tokens.

sophia: minimal repro: convert -> load on redwood-hosted -> run our embed-batch script. Cosine sims look shifted.

alexa: can you paste the config snippets?

sophia: sure. excerpt from the HF repo config.json before convert:
```json
{
  "architectures": ["BertForMaskedLM"],
  "hidden_size": 768,
  "model_max_length": 512,
  "tokenizer_class": "BertTokenizerFast",
  "special_tokens_map": {
    "cls_token": "[CLS]",
    "pad_token": "[PAD]",
    "sep_token": "[SEP]"
  },
  "pooling": "mean"
}
```

sophia: after conversion the Redwood bundle config.json looks like:
```json
{
  "model_max_length": 1024,
  "tokenizer_class": "BertTokenizerFast",
  "special_tokens_map": {
    "pad_token": "[PAD]",
    "sep_token": "[SEP]"
  }
}
```

sophia: notice cls_token missing, pooling key removed, model_max_length bumped.

mike: that explains a lot. our embed runtime defaults to CLS pooling when cls_token exists, otherwise falls back to first-token pooling. If cls token got dropped the anchor for pooling changed.

alexa: also model_max_length affects truncation strategy in the tokenizer pipeline; converting to 1024 may flip truncation side or activate different chunking. Did you see truncation warnings in logs?

sophia: a few lines: `Tokenizer truncated input from 580 to 1024` — not a crash but semantics changed. our original inputs were trimmed to 512 with right-side truncation.

jordan: quantization could amplify small tokenization shifts. Did you run same quant config pre/post?

sophia: yes, both were int8 dynamic via qlayer v2. No large perf diffs, but quality delta only after convert.

toni: quick checks to run: 1) force the original special tokens into the converted tokenizer and re-run eval; 2) force pooling:"mean" in Redwood bundle metadata and retry; 3) run per-example cosine delta and look at examples with big shifts.

alexa: I can add a small CLI flag to the convert tool to preserve explicit special_tokens_map and pooling from HF model_card. Will open a tiny PR.

sophia: thanks. in the meantime I tried a quick hotfix: patched converted tokenizer with `tokenizer.add_special_tokens({"cls_token":"[CLS]"})` and re-encoded a sample. Cosine similarity for anchors jumped from 0.72 -> 0.94 for same doc pairs. Big change.

mike: cool. For truncation: check `tokenizer.truncation_side` and `tokenizer.model_max_length`. We should keep HF model_max_length if exists and respect `truncation_strategy:"longest_first"` vs `right`. Our embed pipeline expects right-side truncation for doc-query pairs.

jordan: sample command to inspect tokenizer after conversion:
```
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("/rwd/models/my-model")
print(t.special_tokens_map)
print(t.model_max_length, t.truncation_side)
```

embed-bot: scheduled quick-run:reranker-eval on redwood-ci (job 4312) — will run once PR lands.

sophia: another gotcha: we use CLS pooling only when `cls_token` maps to a distinct token id and model supports it. If converted tokenizer maps CLS -> same id as [PAD] (bug seen), pooling becomes ambiguous.

toni: noted. adapter test: create a tiny unit test that fails if pooling key is missing or mapping is inconsistent. add to conversion CI.

alexa: PR opened: rwdx-convert#187 — preserves `special_tokens_map` and copies model_card.pooling -> bundle.metadata.pooling. Added a flag `--strict-tokens` to fail conversion if required tokens are missing.

sophia: awesome. after PR merged I'll re-run the full MS MARCO eval and post numbers.

mike: one more suggestion: embed pipeline should log a small checksum of tokenizer special tokens + pooling mode in the inference trace for debugging regressions. short term we can log it to console.

jordan: agreed. also add a small regression test: convert HF repo -> load bundle -> compute embeddings for 50 seeded docs and compare to golden hashes. failing if cosine mean < 0.98.

sophia: adding that to the onboarding checklist. thanks all :heart:

embed-bot: job 4312 queued by alexa, ETA ~12m.
